Lower anterior myometrial thickness (MT) between the bladder and the gestational sac in early pregnancy
outcome: Serious complications during pregnancy, such as intraoperative blood loss ≥1000 mL or with severe forms of morbidly adherent placenta (MAP; placenta increta or placenta percreta)
cohort: 21 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) after expectant management
finding: Lower anterior MT around the gestational sac was correlated with severe complications, such as massive intraoperative bleeding or severe forms of MAP in patients with CSP.
